aboutPreview.primaryText: For years, we have guided pilgrims across continents with sincerity, Islamic scholarship, and logistical precision. Our dedicated team works tirelessly to deliver Hajj and Umrah journeys that feel both spiritually rich and seamlessly organized.
aboutPreview.secondaryText: Founded with a vision to help the Bangladeshi community experience the holy lands with dignity, comfort, and peace of mind. Whether you are interacting with our digital portal or visiting our physical branches, our focus on professional, faith-centered service defines every itinerary we curate.

r1.name: Abdur Rahman
r1.text: Alhamdulillah, my Hajj journey with Pothik Bondhu was incredibly smooth. Their Moallem (guide) was very knowledgeable, and the hotel in Makkah was exactly as close as they promised. Highly recommended.

r2.name: Fatima Begum
r2.text: I was worried about traveling with my elderly mother, but the agency handled everything. From the wheelchair assistance at Jeddah airport to the hotel arrangements, their service was outstanding.

r3.name: Tariqul Islam
r3.text: The visa processing was incredibly fast! I submitted my physical passport to the Comilla branch, and within days I got my e-Visa on the dashboard. Very transparent pricing, no hidden costs.

visa.title: Official Visa Requirements
visa.subtitle: Ensure you have all the necessary documents for a smooth visa processing experience.
visa.hajjPanelDesc: Hajj visas have strict quotas and rigorous medical requirements. Please prepare the following well in advance.
visa.umrahPanelDesc: Umrah e-Visas are processed rapidly. Ensure your digital documents are clear and readable.
visa.passportDesc: Must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of travel, with two blank pages facing each other.
visa.nidDesc: Clear color photocopy of your Smart NID. For minors, a computerized Birth Certificate is required.
visa.photoDesc: 4 recent passport-size photographs (4x4 cm) with a pure white background. Do not wear glasses.
visa.vaccineDesc: Original vaccination certificate for ACYW135 (Meningitis). Must be valid for 3 years.
visa.medDesc: A general health certificate from a certified medical practitioner confirming you are fit for travel.
visa.bioDesc: Mandatory biometric fingerprint registration through the official Saudi Visa Bio app.
visa.scannedPassportDesc: A high-quality color scan of your passport's bio-data page. Must be valid for at least 6 months.
visa.digitalPhotoDesc: Soft copy of a recent passport-size photo with a white background. Minimum resolution 600x600 pixels.
visa.nidCopyDesc: Clear photocopy of your Bangladeshi National ID card.
visa.umrahBioDesc: Mandatory biometric fingerprint registration through the official Saudi Visa Bio app before departure.
